name: Bộ Công an residence portal (đăng ký / gia hạn tạm trú)

status.description: Where the portal tab is: no-portal-tab | login-needed (returned as {stop}) | dossier-list (dossier/procedure/status/id rows, covers both the ho-so.html filed list and the xem-ho-so.html Chưa gửi/Mới đăng ký/... lists; id is the numeric dossier id edit() needs) | form-open (dossier code, fee, declarer, members, attachment rows) | payment | portal.

open.description: Open the procedure entry: TAMTRU_02 (gia hạn) through the ministry portal, TAMTRU_01 (đăng ký) straight on the cư trú form since its ministry entry died on 2026-09-16. Logged out, it lands on the VNeID SSO page, which stays with the human.

incognito.description: default false. The main Helium profile is rejected by the VNeID SSO WAF; true opens a fresh browser context instead, where the human logs in.

edit.description: Reopen a saved draft or filed dossier in the form view by its numeric id (from the list page's update_hoso_dvc(<id>,2)).

fill.description: Fill the residence form from a household object: province/ward, declarer auto-fill (chkIS_REPORTER), case code, address, term, phone, email, note, members (name/dob/sex/id/rel), filer roles, liability tick, fee check. No submit.

members.description: [{name, dob, sex: 2|3, id, rel: 04 Vợ | 05 Chồng | 08 Con}]

procedure.description: TAMTRU_01 | TAMTRU_02 ...; picks cboBPROC_TYPE_CODE before the case (needed when open() landed on the bare form)

attach.description: Attachment rows + uploads. Row 0 is the portal fixed CT01 row (TAMTRU_01 also fixes row 1, giấy tờ chứng minh chỗ ở hợp pháp, after subcase loads); entries without row are created with name. Verified by row text, since the input reads back empty after the AJAX upload.

attachments.description: [{row?: 0, name?: string, type: 1 bản gốc | 2 bản sao | 6 giấy tờ điện tử, files: [absolute paths]}]

subcase.description: TAMTRU_01 only: index of the thành phần hồ sơ sub-case to load before the rows exist (0 = chỗ ở hợp pháp thuộc quyền sở hữu của mình, 1 = chủ hộ/chủ sở hữu đồng ý, 2 = thuê/mượn/ở nhờ)

draft.description: Lưu nháp after dropping blank member rows; returns the G01 dossier code(s) visible on the page it lands on.

printCt01.description: Click In CT01 with downloads allowed into dir; the portal always writes CT01.pdf.

submit.description: Nộp hồ sơ by a real coordinate click (a synthetic click is popup-blocked and the portal reports a payment-gateway error). Polls for the Vietcombank payment URL, which the human then pays.
